decisions.reason: This safety shoe line sits squarely in the firm’s core knowledge base and its move from a general mention to its own page by 2024 suggests management can learn from early demand and scale it commercially.

Although related to the footwear business, the comfort insole remained only marginally presented while the firm’s stronger learning and differentiation appear to be concentrating on more advanced, better-evidenced insole solutions such as the moulded offering.

The supportive insole is close to existing capabilities but two years of only limited visibility indicate weak enough traction that resources are better shifted to the firm’s more distinctive ergonomic footwear and customised insole developments.

An ergonomic safety shoe series strongly matches the firm’s established product-development and specialist fit expertise, and its dedicated page in both years signals a product the firm can continue refining and exploiting effectively.

Firefighter and rescue boots extend the firm’s protective-footwear know-how into a demanding adjacent segment, and the upgrade to a dedicated page by 2024 points to positive early results worth building on.

The moulded insole clearly leverages the firm’s foot-measurement tools, service network and custom-fit knowledge, and its continued home-page prominence plus a named customer-use case show strong market learning and commercial promise.
